description: AI Whodunit — Turborepo + pnpm + TypeScript. Evidence-gated pipeline enforcing 100% coverage on deterministic code, real-DB integration, and no hallucinating tests.

code.description: Implement the planned changes with their full test suite

lint.description: ESLint with zero tolerance for warnings
lint.fix_hints: Fix all ESLint errors AND warnings (CI runs with --max-warnings 0). Do not disable rules to pass; fix the code.

typecheck.fix_hints: Fix all type errors. tsconfig is strict (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes). Do not use 'any' or '@ts-ignore' to silence errors.

test.description: Vitest unit tests with 100% coverage gate on deterministic packages
test.fix_hints: All unit tests must pass AND coverage must be 100% (line+branch) on deterministic packages. Coverage thresholds are configured in each package's vitest config and the command fails below them. Add REAL tests that exercise the implementation — never assert on mocks written to pass, never lower a threshold, never add coverage-ignore comments to dodge the gate.

test_integration.description: DB integration tests against a real Postgres
test_integration.fix_hints: Integration tests run against a REAL Postgres (never a mocked DB). Ensure migrations apply and assertions check real persisted state.

test_contract.description: API/contract tests incl. the server-authoritative payload scan
test_contract.fix_hints: Contract tests assert tRPC/SSE behavior against a real test DB, including the invariant that NO client-bound payload contains any dossier field, secret, or isGuilty. LLM behavior uses recorded-fixture replay, not exact-string asserts.

test_e2e.description: Playwright end-to-end the full play flow
test_e2e.fix_hints: Drive the real app in a real browser through the full play flow. Do not stub the UI.

test_smoke.description: Smoke — every route loads without error
test_smoke.fix_hints: Every route must load without console/network error.

test_visual.fix_hints: Screenshot baselines for board, interrogation, accusation, paywall. Only update baselines when the visual change is intended.

code_review.description: Adversarial review for correctness, the grounding invariant, and test honesty
